title: Domain Inheritance Crisis
summary: A dead or vanished power-holder has left behind territory, retainers, and obligations that several factions now claim.
use: Use as a long-form domain struggle involving boons, contested legitimacy, and escalating reprisals.

title: Masquerade Audit
summary: A cluster of digital traces, witness accounts, and financial anomalies suggests someone is mapping predation patterns in the city.
use: Use for a slow-burn hunter pressure arc or political cover-up that forces the character into uncomfortable alliances.

title: Blood Supply Capture
summary: A faction is quietly consolidating access to clinics, couriers, herd pipelines, and feeding routes across the city.
use: Use for a campaign-scale fight over survival logistics, dependency, and coercive patronage.

title: Buried Elder Agenda
summary: Old favors and sealed instructions begin surfacing, implying an elder planned the current unrest years before it started.
use: Use for layered reveals, inherited enemies, and a sense that the character has walked into a prewritten trap.
